name: GXO LOGISTICS SUPPLY CHAIN INC
title: WARN notice and update, GXO Logistics Supply Chain, Inc., West Jefferson (Madison County), closure, 102 affected, March 3 and April 28, 2026
publisher: Ohio Department of Job and Family Services
notes: Fetched and read in full. The PDF holds both letters from Casey Morales, Senior Director, Human Resources, GXO. The original, dated March 3, 2026 and stamped Received: 3/3/2026 @ 12:06pm, says GXO Logistics Supply Chain, Inc. will cease its operations on behalf of GXO's client at the facility located at 202 Park West Drive, West Jefferson, OH 43162 no later than May 2, 2026, that the action is expected to be permanent, that all 102 affected employees have been notified, that there are no bumping rights and no union, and attaches a schedule of job losses (35 material handlers, 18 PIT operators, 8 clerks, 8 leads and others). The update, dated April 28, 2026 and stamped Received: 4/28/2026 @ 4:10pm, extends ten separations to June 1, July 1 and August 1, 2026 and notes that some impacted employees secured positions at other GXO sites. Both letters copy Mayor Ray Martin of West Jefferson. The state 2026 WARN table row reads West Jefferson/Madison, Closure, 102, layoff date 5/2/2026.
